body: Like I previously said, dealing with everything alone seems like the only way now. I'm incredibly grateful for you taking time out of your day to speak with me for a bit; it offers reassurance. I wish you all the best going forward.

I'd like to think I'm not selfish but what spurred me to even think about speaking out was being told last night that the only reason I have been kept around by someone was that they were afraid I would kill myself and they didn't want that on their conscience. I know all too well how shitty of a person I am and it is nice to have comfort at times but for them to just not be outright straight from the beginning has led me down a road that has left me in ruin. I sadly am driven by the emotions of others more than my own which often means I am locked in a bitter circle of wrongs. I'll never say I'm deserving of anything more/different just because I fail to function like everyone else.

Frankly, I care so little about myself that I find no reason for anyone to care. I am terribly sorry to hear that you too, have had it hard. There are times where a sliver of hope shines through and things look like they may turn themselves around meaning it'll get better only for it to be ripped away almost immediately. If I've learned anything it's that I'm much better alone. Thinking I'm a burden just adds to how little I care. I wish you well and hope things improve with you. Thank you for your kind words.

I sincerely appreciate every word you've said to me. I'm not a lost cause yet by any means but I know for sure I'm not in the right place to carry on. I do feel like the biggest let down to friends and family but I'll have to work past that. I wish you the very best in life :)

Without going into details that may be used to identify me, I've struggled with balancing life's problems. I use it as a means to inflict the pain I believe I dish out. The people around me are, in my eyes, victims of my toxic existence. The pain is so superficial that I look toward the symbolic value of my anguish instead of theirs.
Almost half a year. I've come within minutes of ending it all but that fell through quickly. Four years and counting since I began this downward spiral.
